food-haitang-cake.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Suzhou haitanggao, traditional begonia-shaped molded sweet cakes. Three small squat cakes with a recognizably gently lobed flower outline, golden baked batter sides and a flat glossy dark amber caramelized sugar top scattered with a few sesame seeds, tiny melon seeds and thin candied-fruit flecks. One split cake shows dark red bean paste inside. The cakes are edible street pastries, not decorative flowers, not cupcakes, not tall meihuagao topped with white rice balls.
